title: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Echoes Robert Downey Jr.'s MCU Debut
excerpt:
The latest poster reportedly recalls the original Iron Man campaign.
It comes two decades after Downey was cast as Tony Stark.
body_md:
Twenty years after Jon Favreau cast Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark, the marketing for Avengers: Doomsday is revisiting the origins of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. According to the available article summary, its latest poster recalls the promotional campaign for the original Iron Man.

Released in 2008, Iron Man launched the MCU and established Downey as one of its defining performers. Tony Stark's journey reached a major conclusion in 2019's Avengers: Endgame.

Downey's return as Victor von Doom rather than Tony Stark gives the marketing callback a different significance. An actor once associated with Marvel's central heroes is now portraying one of their most prominent adversaries.

The promotional parallel does not establish a narrative connection between Iron Man and Doctor Doom. The available report identifies a marketing callback but does not provide further details about the poster's design or the film's plot.
